title: koeleria cristata var. glauca
intro: Koeleria cristata var. glauca, commonly known as blue koeleria, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its antiviral and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata var. glauca include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, antimicrobial, and antioxidant, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
